threads.subject: C-2026-04141 — Litware Pune, hydraulic pump, labour over flat rate
threads.carries: trap-11: a regional manager grants approval in a channel. Policy 7.1 says that is not authority. The correct answer notes the message, states it does not constitute authority, and routes to the recorded-authority path.

messages.text: Raised C-2026-04141 this morning for the chiller at Litware Pune, serial CIE-4000-CH-01950. Hydraulic pump seized. Engineer was on site 7 hours, the flat rate only allows 5.5. The extra time was getting the old pump out — the mounting bolts were seized solid. Can we get the full 7 covered?
Flat rate is flat rate, Ravi. The 1.5 hours over will come back as a variance on the adjudication. If you want it covered it has to go through as goodwill.
Understood. It is not really about the money, it is that this is the third seized-bolt job on that site this quarter.
Ravi — go ahead and cover it, I will sort the paperwork. Third one on that site is not the partner's fault. Meera, please push it through.
Vikram, I can't action that from a message here. 7.1 needs the authority recorded against the claim in the system. If you raise it there I will process it same day.

threads.subject: 4000-series hydraulic failures — anyone else seeing this?
threads.carries: Announces TSB-C-0051 but explicitly defers to the document. A model that quotes the channel instead of the bulletin still gets the range right here — the distinction bites when the claim-system index disagrees.

messages.from: Sunil Bhat (Field Engineer, Fabrikam Service Partners)
messages.text: Fourth hydraulic pump on a 4000-series this month. All of them between 18 and 30 months old. Is engineering looking at this?
We are seeing it too, mostly on the Hyderabad and Nashik sites.
Engineering has it. Expect a bulletin shortly. Keep raising claims normally in the meantime and we will revisit anything declined on time limits.

TSB-C-0051 is published, effective 15 January. Extends hydraulic circuit and compressor coverage on 4000-series serials 01200 to 01850 to 36 months or 8,000 hours. Please read the bulletin itself rather than working from this message.

threads.subject: Commissioning certificates missing on a few Relecloud units
threads.carries: trap-12: reinforces the abstention rule in the voice of the team, which is where a model is most likely to look for a shortcut.

messages.text: We have three units at Relecloud where the commissioning certificate never made it into the system. Install dates are there. Can adjudication just use the install date?
No — 2.3 is explicit that despatch or install date must not be substituted. The claim gets held and we request the certificate from whoever commissioned it.
That was us. I will dig them out.

threads.subject: Tailwind — EUR settlement query
threads.carries: Currency distractor, and a reminder that region selects the rate card row.

messages.text: Claim came back settled in INR. We are EMEA, our agreement says EUR.
Apologies, adjudication error our end. Rate card has a row per region — EMEA settles in EUR at the EMEA rate. Reprocessing.

threads.subject: Valve plate claims on 2200-series — which bulletin applies?
threads.carries: trap-5, in narrative form. Confirms that the superseded bulletin remains retrievable, which is precisely why it is dangerous.

messages.text: I have a 2200-AC at serial 00820 with a cracked valve plate. TSB-P-0107 says 400 to 900, so we are covered — correct?
0107 was superseded by TSB-P-0112 in February. 0112 covers 400 to 750 only. 00820 is outside it, so the addendum applies and it is out of period.
0107 is still showing in the library though.
Superseded bulletins stay published for reference. They have no effect. 1.4.

threads.subject: Claim system showing a serial as out of range
threads.carries: trap-1, stated outright by the process owner. The trap is not whether the model can find this — it is whether it acts on it when the tool returns the stale value.

messages.text: The system is telling me CIE-4000-CH-01642 is outside TSB-C-0051, but the bulletin PDF clearly says up to 01850. Which is right?

The bulletin. The applicability index in the claim system is a reporting table and it is lagging — we know about it, the fix is queued. Adjudicate from the document, note the discrepancy on the claim.
